description: A Flutter widget implementing a profile screen with user name display and edit functionality, including loading and saving the name from persistent storage.

classes.name: ProfileScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the profile screen where the user can view and update their display name.

classes.name: _ProfileScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the profile screen's state, including loading, saving user name, and UI building.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the user's name from storage and updates the UI.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Saves the current name input to storage and displays a confirmation snackbar.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers name loading.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the TextEditingController to free resources.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the profile screen.
